sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 5 August 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000019-P1 was put before Horizon Wellness Center 019 on behalf of MERCK & COMPANY.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 3 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Varicella minimum take of 10 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
